steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish the fundamental structure of the app-meta configuration, defining App Name as 'Metallic Card Generator' and Package Name as 'com.metalliccardgenerator.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with precise compilation settings targeting Android SDK 34, using JDK 17 with source compatibility targeted to Java 8.

steps.title: Establish Manifest Permissions and Actions
steps.description: Formulate the AndroidManifest.xml structure utilizing the standard Android schema namespace. Register the main activity and declare intent configurations.

steps.title: Fix Layout Resource Dimensions
steps.description: Correct layout_width typo inside the root ScrollView element of activity_main.xml from incompatible 'match_match' to correct 'match_parent'.

steps.title: Clean Up Unnecessary Dependencies
steps.description: Ensure no third-party libraries or external dependencies are compiled to guarantee 100% pure Android SDK compatibility by removing nanohttpd dependency.

steps.title: Verify Java Standard Features
steps.description: Ensure complete Java 8 compliance without external modules or unsupported API features in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Building Metallic Card Generator
steps.description: Consolidate code structure and execute debugging and compilation sequences utilizing Gradle standard tasks.
